text.steered: α·v̂ is added to the residual stream at the selected layers on the highlighted subject tokens during the prompt pass, then on every generated token. img2txt feeds this same input (no image); only the vector, built from image pairs, differs. The α = 0 row is unsteered.
text.decoding: Greedy decoding, up to 96 new tokens. Gemma chat template; the tokenizer adds <bos>.

image.cond: <bos>{prompt} Generate an image based on this description.<boi>
image.steered: α·v̂ is added only at the generated image-token positions of the conditional stream. The text prefix and the unconditional (CFG) input shown here are never steered. img2img and txt2img use this same input; only the vector source differs. α = 0 is unsteered.
image.decoding: CFG 7.0, top-k 4096, top-p 0.96, temperature 0.99 over image tokens only, seed 42; VQGAN-decoded to 512×512 px.
